analysis.overall: You had a fantastic day with 96% time in range and an average glucose of 124 mg/dL. Aside from a couple of temporary peaks following snacks and meals, your levels bounced back quickly without staying high.

events.title: Afternoon rise
events.description: Glucose drifted up to a day-high of 193 mg/dL, prompting several small corrections that brought you steadily back down over the next two hours.

events.title: Brief evening low
events.description: The momentum from the afternoon drop caused a momentary dip to 69 mg/dL, but a temp target helped bring you back into target range within 30 minutes.

events.title: Late-night snack spike
events.description: A late 15g snack combined with a few correction doses caused glucose to climb to 189 mg/dL before settling down after midnight.

events.title: Rock-solid overnight baseline
events.description: Your numbers remained exceptionally steady right around 100–110 mg/dL through the entire night.

events.title: Late-morning meal rise
events.description: A 50g carb meal raised glucose to 178 mg/dL, where your bolus successfully caught it and started bringing it down.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Notice how late-night snacks tend to linger into elevated readings right at bedtime—bolusing earlier or keeping late carbs minimal can help keep nights even smoother.
